CustomField.description: Amount Pending to be received for the installment line.
CustomField.formula:
IF( ADM_Fee_Included__c && InstallmentNumber__c = 1,
IF( ISBLANK(AmountReceived__c) || AmountReceived__c = 0, Installment_Amount_Excluding_ADM__c - BLANKVALUE(TotalRebateAmount__c, 0),
IF( AmountReceived__c > 0 && AmountReceived__c < Installment_Amount_Excluding_ADM__c,
Installment_Amount_Excluding_ADM__c - AmountReceived__c - BLANKVALUE(TotalRebateAmount__c, 0),
0 ) ),
IF( ISBLANK(AmountReceived__c) || AmountReceived__c = 0,
InstallmentAmount__c - BLANKVALUE(TotalRebateAmount__c, 0),
IF( AmountReceived__c > 0 && AmountReceived__c < InstallmentAmount__c,
InstallmentAmount__c - AmountReceived__c - BLANKVALUE(TotalRebateAmount__c, 0),
0 ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Amount Pending to be received for the installment line.
CustomField.label: Pending Amount
